title: The invoice arrives before the goods are booked in
description: Both lines of the PO billed in full. The bearings were received on 18 Nov; the timing belts are not booked in yet, so the invoice waits for Stores and for nothing else.

title: A small supplier's invoice, three days from the legal pay-by date
description: 2,000 cartons delivered on 10 Oct and billed at Rs 40.00 against Rs 38.50 on the PO. The supplier is a registered micro enterprise, so the statutory pay-by date is 45 days from delivery.
